class.name: GameplayNetworkSimulator
class.brief_description: Seeded application-layer latency, jitter, and loss adapter for tests.
class.description: GameplayNetworkSimulator queues transport dictionaries with deterministic seeded delay and loss. It is intended for controlled tests and samples, not as a replacement for transport-level network emulation. Queue size and all configured values are bounded.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears queued packets and drop counters while retaining configuration.

method.name: drain
method.description: Returns and removes every packet whose deterministic delivery time has arrived.

method.name: discard_target
method.description: Removes delayed packets for a disconnected peer and returns the removed count.

method.name: enqueue
method.description: Queues, drops, or rejects a copied message and reports the outcome.

method.name: get_overflow_packet_count
method.description: Returns packets rejected or trimmed by the queue limit.

method.name: get_queued_packet_count
method.description: Returns the current bounded queue size.

method.name: get_seed
method.description: Returns the current deterministic generator state.

method.name: set_seed
method.description: Resets the deterministic generator; zero maps to a nonzero state.
